votes.reason: REGN leads Healthcare, my strongest call: it rose 3.9% last week and 27.3% over four weeks on the FDA-approval news that lets the sector move apart from SPY, so it owns the breakout directly.

UNH is labelled Healthcare but does not follow my Healthcare call: it fell 2.9% in the week XLV broke out to an all-time high and is down 7.3% over four weeks while REGN and LLY rose, and as an insurer it gets none of the FDA-approval and Phase 3 news the call rests on, so its 20% adds to the book's healthcare weight without the sector's momentum.
At about 12% of XLV and up 6.4% in the breakout week, LLY is the most direct single stock for my Healthcare call.

Financials is not one of my four sectors, but I made no call against it, and an insurer whose float earns more as yields rise hedges the same risk my Energy call hedges and my Staples call fears: a hot PCE or a hawkish Warsh pushing the 10-year up.

COP fits my Energy call exactly as a large oil producer up 7.1% on the week and 12.9% over four weeks on the Hormuz supply cut, and holding it to 10% respects my warning that the war premium drains fast if tankers move or talks restart, with XLE's RSI at 71.7.
